skill.name: limrun-xcode
skill.description: Build non-Bazel Apple projects on Limrun remote Xcode from Linux, Windows, macOS, virtual machines, or containers.
skill.summary: Run remote Xcode builds, simulator installs, signed IPA exports, previews, and App Store uploads with Limrun.
skill.author: limrun-inc

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, command fences, identifiers, and a documented URL. Confirmed risks involve soliciting an API key and transmitting Apple signing certificates and passwords to a remote build service. Semantic review also identified unpinned global package installation, source-code upload, and privileged App Store credential transfer.

remediation.suggestion: Pin an exact lim package version, verify package provenance and integrity, and document supported versions before global installation.
Require informed user approval before source sync, document retention and access controls, and exclude secrets and unnecessary files.

remediation.issue: Signing and App Store credentials sent remotely
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit approval, use ephemeral least-privileged keys, avoid passwords in process arguments, redact logs, and document remote secret handling.
Remove requests to provide API keys in conversation. Direct users to interactive login or a protected environment variable instead.

content.user_title: Build Apple Apps on Remote Xcode
content.value_statement: Local Apple builds require macOS and Xcode infrastructure. This skill sends projects to Limrun for remote builds, simulator installation, signing, previews, and App Store uploads.
actual_capabilities: Builds Xcode projects and workspaces on Limrun remote Xcode instances.
Generates gitignored Xcode projects from XcodeGen project specifications before building.
Builds React Native and Expo native iOS projects with optional development server URLs.
Installs and relaunches successful builds on an attached remote simulator.
Creates signed device IPA files using cloud signing or supplied certificates and profiles.
Uploads build artifacts to Limrun storage or App Store Connect.
limitations: Requires the Limrun CLI, network access, authentication, and access to Limrun remote infrastructure.
Does not support Bazel workspaces; those require the separate limrun-xcode-bazel skill.
Simulator taps, screenshots, recordings, and element inspection require the limrun-ios-simulator skill.
Large files, absolute symlinks, and links outside the synced root can prevent source synchronization.

use_cases.title: Build iOS Without Local Xcode
use_cases.description: Compile and install an Apple application from Linux, Windows, macOS, a virtual machine, or a container.
use_cases.target_user: Mobile developers without a suitable local Mac

use_cases.title: Automate Remote Apple Builds
use_cases.description: Run repeatable Debug or Release builds for projects, workspaces, XcodeGen, React Native, and Expo repositories.
use_cases.target_user: CI engineers maintaining Apple build pipelines

use_cases.title: Prepare and Deliver Signed IPAs
use_cases.description: Create signed device artifacts and upload approved releases to storage or App Store Connect.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Basic Xcode Project
prompt_templates.prompt: Build the Apple project in [project path] with Limrun. Use the default scheme and report the build result and artifact location.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner remote build with project defaults

prompt_templates.title: Build a Selected Workspace
prompt_templates.prompt: Build [workspace] with scheme [scheme] and configuration [Debug or Release]. Attach a remote simulator only when installation or interaction is required.
prompt_templates.scenario: Configured workspace build and optional simulator installation

prompt_templates.title: Create a Signed Device IPA
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a signed IPA for [bundle identifier] using [cloud or manual] signing. Ask before transmitting credentials, then report the secure download location.
prompt_templates.scenario: Release artifact creation for registered devices

prompt_templates.title: Deliver an App Store Build
prompt_templates.prompt: Build [project] for App Store Connect, increment the build number, and sign with least-privileged credentials. Upload after my explicit confirmation and report processing status.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced signing and controlled App Store delivery

output_examples.input: Build the default project in Debug and install it on the attached simulator.
output: The remote Debug build completed for scheme MyApp.
The application was installed and relaunched on the attached simulator.

output_examples.input: Create a signed release IPA and keep the artifact for fourteen days.
output: Release IPA signing passed the server verification.
The artifact upload completed with a fourteen-day retention period.

output_examples.input: Upload the approved release to App Store Connect and wait for its status.

best_practices: Confirm the source path, scheme, workspace, configuration, and target before starting a remote build.
Use interactive login and least-privileged, short-lived signing credentials whenever possible.
Request explicit approval before source upload, credential transmission, artifact publication, or App Store delivery.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys, certificate passwords, private keys, or signed access URLs into conversation history.
Do not use this skill for Bazel workspaces or local simulator automation.
Do not retry an accepted App Store upload while Apple is still processing it.

faq.question: Do I need macOS or local Xcode?
faq.answer: No. The project is synchronized to Limrun and built on remote Xcode infrastructure.

faq.question: Does this skill support Bazel workspaces?
faq.answer: No. Use the limrun-xcode-bazel skill for Bazel-based Apple projects.

faq.question: Can it interact with the running simulator?
faq.answer: It can install and relaunch builds. Use limrun-ios-simulator for taps, typing, screenshots, recordings, and element inspection.

faq.question: Which project types are supported?
faq.answer: It supports Xcode projects, workspaces, XcodeGen specifications, React Native native builds, and Expo native builds.

faq.question: How are signed IPA files created?
faq.answer: The skill supports Apple cloud signing or manual signing with a certificate and matching provisioning profiles.

faq.question: Can it upload directly to App Store Connect?
faq.answer: Yes. It can sign and upload an approved build using an App Store Connect API key.
